notes.title: Devlog and playtest update to v.0.1.1.2234
notes.content:
Ahoy my fellow Captains!

We've finally ready to extend playtest as we've added and hopefully fixed some new stuff and we need your reviews!
Full patch notes since previous release:
[list]
[*] Updated compass for better visibility of items, now shows the wind and targets
[*] Reworked Neverseas Traversal: added map and finally Mist Stones have some usage
[*] Reworked ship combat completely
[*] Reworked melee combat and updated animations
[*] Updated tutorial to fit new ship controls and implemented it using new quest system
[*] Added some repeatable easy quests to have a goal in sailing and for debug reasons
[*] Added some ship modules: 
[list]
[*] Basic equipment: supplies you with character weapons and consumables
[*] Gift from the Mist: supplies you with ship ammunition
[*] Ship carpentry: for a few wooden logs will refill your repair kit to fix ship while damaged
[/list]
[*] Updated interaction system - now should work smoothly in most cases
[*] Added a few more debug functions in game chat to be used in situations when you stuck:
[list]
[*] /wu me - makes wind follow you
[*] /kill - in case of NPC spawning somewhere randomly in rocks, kills all nearby NPC
[*] T button while controlling the ship - if you stuck, pushes ship backwards a bit
[*] T button while on foot - teleport to the ship, now works as debuff
[/list]
[*] Updated weather
[*] Updated ship loot to fit your gameplay needs better
[*] Update HUD to fit all necessary elements and control buttons
[/list]
Some side note tips for a map as it's not in its final form and thus have no separate tutorial.
Once you have a quest you need to find a map, interact with it, having Mist stone in your inventory.
First you choose a destination, by default those are habitable islands (no use for you now) marked with Church and quest islands, marked with Lighthouses.
Then you choose waypoints you gotta follow to get somewhere starting from your ship, marked as, who would've guessed, ship.
Now you see "Island" mark on the compass to follow. New quests will appear on the ship mast after you complete the first once you pick on starting island. Maps are seen on map with compass icon.

notes.title: Playtest update, build rev 1966
notes.content:
Hello, my fellow Captain!

Numerous bugs fixed, including visual bugs, interaction issues, missing ships spawn, etc.

Added Beta feature - Ship customization and repairs. Now it is available by pressing V anywhere in the world. In the future this one will be a part of shipyard.
You can swap canons, update hull, see its statistics there right now.
Notice - this one still WIP. so it might be extremely buggy, but still this allows you to paint ship, switch some modules as well as repair it.
If you find any issues with that make sure to let us know.

Added feature - Traversing Neverseas:
If you sail away from the trajectory shown by the route or just sail random direction, you are getting lost and now you need Stone of Mists to get to the social island.
Now to get to the specific social island, if you are lost, you need to consume Stone of Mists (RMB in inventory and press Use) and light above will show you the way.
Lighthouses works similar way, but they are free: you approach those, interact and chose available route to an island.
To get to an island you gonna need to follow a few steps in a route activating lighthouses all the way till you arrive.

Islands are now divided logically:
Social islands - safe islands where you can now find traders and, in the future, quests, factions and so on.
Route islands - Islands that only appear once you are on a route.
Lost islands - random islands you encounter while travelling off route, main source of resources and battles.

See you on board, Captain!
